The conversation addressed the inclusion of forecast data for Brazilian assets. It was confirmed that if virtual frames are removed from `facility_virtual`, the forecast will no longer be included.

Additionally, a suggestion was made to filter out frames with a 'Suspended' status, though this might complicate the process due to the large volume of frames.
decisions: Forecast data inclusion depends on virtual frames being present in `facility_virtual`.
